{"metadata":{"description":"Gitee AI 员工：在 issue 里 @ 机器人并指定目标分支，它自动克隆仓库开发、提交 PR，可自动合并并关闭 issue。Issue-driven Gitee AI developer for DeepSeek Harness.","id":"gh:1344702556","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"gitee-ai-employee","slug":"wangbobo-coder/gitee-ai-employee","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Gitee AI 员工：在 issue 里 @ 机器人并指定目标分支，它自动克隆仓库开发、提交 PR，可自动合并并关闭 issue。Issue-driven Gitee AI developer fo"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" 里 @ 机器人并指定目标分支，它自动克隆仓库开发、提交 PR，可自动合并并关闭 issue。Issue-driven Gitee AI developer for DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Gitee AI 员工 (gitee-ai-employee)"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"An issue-driven AI developer for **DeepSeek Harness**, working against **Gitee (码云)** and **GitHub**"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"n issue-driven AI developer for **DeepSeek Harness**, working against **Gitee (码云)** and **GitHub**."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Mention your bot in an issue, and the plugin clones the repository, dispatches an AI **worker agent*"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"* to implement the change, pushes a branch, opens a Pull Request to the branch you ask for, and can "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"auto-merge and auto-close the issue. You can watch Gitee and GitHub repositories at the same time."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> 中文说明见 README.zh.md。"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Polling**: periodically scans the issues of the repositories you watch for a new mention of your"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" bot (`@botName`). Dual platform: each watch row can be prefixed `gitee:` or `github:` (unprefixed r"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"ows use `defaultPlatform`, default `gitee`), so you can watch both platforms at once. - **AI develop"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ment**: creates a worker agent in a profile that clones the repo (via PowerShell + `curl` on Windows"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"), explores it, implements the issue, runs checks, and commits on a `ai-fix/issue-` branch. "},{"id":"p7s6","text":"- **Branch-aware**: it reads branch instructions written in natural language and uses that branch as"},{"id":"p7s7","text":" both the development base and the PR target: - `需要修改 release-v1.2 分支` / `修改 X 分支` / `改 X 分支` - `基于 "},{"id":"p7s8","text":"X 分支` / `在 X 分支上` / `以 X 分支为基础` - `合并到 X` / `合到 X` / `目标分支 X` / `base: X` The requested branch is va"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"lidated against the remote with `git ls-remote`; if it does not exist, the plugin falls back to the "},{"id":"p7s10","text":"repository default branch and says so in a comment. - **PR & close**: pushes the branch, creates a P"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"R (base = the chosen branch), optionally auto-merges it (`autoMerge`), and optionally closes the iss"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"ue on success (`autoCloseIssue`). - **Webhook / manual trigger**: optional webhook endpoint and a ma"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"nual trigger URL for instant processing without waiting for the poll. - **Security scanning (v1.2)**"},{"id":"p7s14","text":": configure scan repositories (`scanRepos`) and the plugin drives a scan worker (reusing the DSH mod"},{"id":"p7s15","text":"el) through built-in/custom security prompts to statically audit the cloned code. Findings are **ded"},{"id":"p7s16","text":"uplicated** — the same spot (`file:line` + vulnerability type) is only reported once (dedup state pe"},{"id":"p7s17","text":"rsists at `workRoot/scan-state.json`) — and new findings are submitted as issues automatically. Supp"},{"id":"p7s18","text":"orts scheduled scanning (`scanEnabled` + `scanIntervalMs`) and manual triggering (the "立即扫描" button "},{"id":"p7s19","text":"in the settings card or `POST /gitee-ai/scan`)."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 0.1.x, Windows (the plugin drives `git` and the Gitee API through PowerShel"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"l + `C:\Windows\System32\curl.exe`), a Gitee account with a personal access token. - The worker and "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"scanner presets are **bundled and auto-installed** into `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/gitee-worker` (`gi"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"tee-scanner` likewise) on first load — no manual setup."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"(or if you prefer installing straight from GitHub: `dsh plugin --profile

add github:wangbobo-cod"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"er/gitee-ai-employee`)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Restart dsh, then open **Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration**, find the **Gitee AI 员工** card "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"hen open **Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration**, find the **Gitee AI 员工** card and configure:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Setting | Meaning |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Security scanning (v1.2)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"1. In the plugin config card (or `/gitee-ai/settings`), fill **扫描仓库** with one `[gitee:|github:]owne"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"r/repo` per line, enable **启用定时扫描**, or click **立即扫描全部仓库**. Click **一键获取我的仓库** to auto-fill every re"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"po you can access (own + org memberships) so you can keep/remove entries before saving (equivalent A"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"PI: `GET /gitee-ai/my-repos`). 2. The plugin clones the repo → runs the scan worker with the selecte"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"d security prompts → results land at `/.gitee-scan/result.json` → findings are diffed against "},{"id":"p17s6","text":"`scan-state.json` → **new** findings are submitted as an issue."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"**Built-in prompt ids**: `general` / `sqli` / `xss` / `command-injection` / `path-traversal` / `ssrf"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"` / `hardcoded-secret` / `insecure-deserialization` / `authz` / `dos` / `dependency`."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- Override a built-in by using the same id in `scanPrompts`; add custom ids for new checks. - Dedup "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"signature is `file:line:vulnType`; already-reported signatures are skipped. - `POST /gitee-ai/scan` "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"accepts `dryRun=true` (preview, no issue) and `force=true` (re-report). - `GET /gitee-ai/scan` retur"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"ns the prompt catalog, scan jobs and dedup stats. - Scan issues are titled with a `[安全扫描]` prefix."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Security notes"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- User configuration is persisted to the **user's own profile patch layer**; the shipped `cordis.pat"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ch.yml` contains only an empty default and never a token. - The token is marked secret in the schema"},{"id":"p21s3","text":" and is never echoed by the status/config API (only a `tokenConfigured` boolean). - The plugin runs "},{"id":"p21s4","text":"with the same privileges as your dsh process; its worker agent gets `danger-full-access` inside the "},{"id":"p21s5","text":"cloned workspace only. - The scan worker is read-only static analysis; hardcoded-secret findings rep"},{"id":"p21s6","text":"ort type and location only, never the secret value."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## DSH compatibility (v1.3.1)"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"v1.3.1 fixes "plugin loads fine but every worker/scan fails" on DSH 0.2.x. All three are follow-ups "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"to host API changes:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **shell execution**: 0.2.x dropped `shell.run()`; use `shell.execute(shell.resolve(req)).result()`"},{"id":"p24s2","text":". The old code threw `shell.run is not a function`. - **agent preset registration**: 0.2.x `agentPre"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"sets` only honours an explicit `register(definition)` and no longer scans `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets`"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"; the old code threw `Unknown agent preset: gitee-scanner`. The plugin now both registers in code an"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"d writes the preset directory (compatibility with older builds). - **persona config field**: `@deeps"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"eek-ai/dsh-persona` takes its body as `prefix` (required), not `text`; `text` threw `$.prefix missin"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"` takes its body as `prefix` (required), not `text`; `text` threw `$.prefix missing required value`."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"After upgrading, **restart the DSH process**. The plugin is installed as an npm package and a runnin"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"g process never re-imports new code from disk — toggling the plugin on/off is not enough."}],"truncated":true}
